description: Comprehensive business rules and anti-hallucination guidelines for all 19 tables in the Sales schema.
global_anti_hallucination_rules: Use only tables and columns explicitly present in the Sales schema context.
Do not invent external tables or schemas (such as Production.Product, Person.Person, Purchasing.Vendor) unless they are provided in the prompt.
Always use fully qualified table names (e.g. Sales.SalesOrderHeader, Sales.SalesOrderDetail).
Never execute DML/DDL statements (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, ALTER, CREATE, TRUNCATE, EXEC). Generate read-only SELECT queries only.
Never use LIMIT syntax; SQL Server requires TOP N or OFFSET-FETCH.

financial_rules.SubTotal: Pure merchandise revenue before tax and freight. SUM(SubTotal) represents Revenue / Sales Revenue.
financial_rules.TotalDue: Grand total charged to customer (SubTotal + TaxAmt + Freight). Use SUM(TotalDue) when user explicitly asks for Total Due, Amount Due, or Total Customer Charge.
financial_rules.TaxAmt: Sales tax collected. SUM(TaxAmt) represents Tax Collected.
financial_rules.Freight: Shipping/freight charges. SUM(Freight) represents Freight Charges.

channel_enum.0: Order placed offline by sales representative
channel_enum.1: Order placed online directly by customer

anti_hallucination_guidance: TerritoryID is directly present on SalesOrderHeader. Do not join Sales.SalesTerritory unless territory names or regional groups are explicitly requested.
Do not sum header-level financial fields (SubTotal, TotalDue, TaxAmt, Freight) after joining to SalesOrderDetail without grouping by SalesOrderID first.

Sales.SalesOrderDetail.grain: one row per product line within a sales order

financial_rules.OrderQty: Quantity of product ordered. SUM(OrderQty) represents Units Sold.
financial_rules.UnitPrice: Unit selling price of a single product item. Never sum UnitPrice directly; use AVG(UnitPrice).
financial_rules.UnitPriceDiscount: Discount rate fraction (e.g., 0.10 represents a 10% discount). Never sum UnitPriceDiscount; use AVG(UnitPriceDiscount).
financial_rules.LineTotal: Computed per product subtotal: UnitPrice * (1 - UnitPriceDiscount) * OrderQty.

anti_hallucination_guidance: SalesOrderDetail does NOT contain SubTotal, TotalDue, TaxAmt, or Freight. Use LineTotal for line-item product sales value.
SalesOrderDetail joins to SalesOrderHeader on SalesOrderID.

account_types.PersonID: Refers to individual consumer accounts (links to Person.Person).
account_types.StoreID: Refers to corporate reseller or retail store accounts (links to Sales.Store).

anti_hallucination_guidance: CustomerID is the primary key for sales orders in SalesOrderHeader.
Do not join Person.Person or Sales.Store unless customer personal names or store names are explicitly requested.

Sales.Store.grain: one row per store reseller account
rules: SalesPersonID links to the assigned SalesPerson who handles the account.
Demographics column contains XML-encoded store survey data.

performance_metrics.SalesYTD: Year-to-date total sales achieved by the representative.
performance_metrics.SalesLastYear: Previous year total sales achieved by the representative.

anti_hallucination_guidance: BusinessEntityID is the primary key identifying the sales person (links to SalesOrderHeader.SalesPersonID).

Sales.SalesTerritory.grain: one row per sales territory region

geographic_grouping.Group: Geographic continent/group (e.g., North America, Europe, Pacific).
geographic_grouping.CountryRegionCode: ISO Country/Region code (e.g., US, CA, FR, DE, AU).

performance_metrics.SalesYTD: Aggregated year-to-date sales for the territory.
performance_metrics.SalesLastYear: Aggregated previous year sales for the territory.

Sales.SpecialOffer.grain: one row per promotional special offer

discount_rules.Type: Category of offer (e.g. Volume Discount, Excess Inventory, Discontinued, Season Discount).

Sales.SpecialOfferProduct.grain: one row per product mapped to a special offer
anti_hallucination_guidance: Acts as a bridge table linking promotions in SpecialOffer to item line details in SalesOrderDetail on (SpecialOfferID, ProductID).

rules: CardType stores card brand (Vista, SuperiorCard, Distinguish, ColonialVoice).

Sales.PersonCreditCard.grain: one row per person credit card mapping
rules: Maps individual customer persons (BusinessEntityID) to their stored payment cards (CreditCardID).
CurrencyCode stores ISO 3-letter currency abbreviation (USD, EUR, CAD, AUD, GBP).

Sales.CurrencyRate.grain: one row per currency exchange rate per date
rules: FromCurrencyCode and ToCurrencyCode identify source and target conversion currencies.
AverageRate and EndOfDayRate represent conversion multipliers.

Sales.CountryRegionCurrency.grain: one row per country region and currency mapping
rules: Maps geographic countries to their official local trading currency.

Sales.SalesReason.grain: one row per sales reason category
rules: ReasonType categorizes order purchase reasons (e.g. Marketing, Promotion, Other).

Sales.SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason.grain: one row per sales order and sales reason association
rules: Bridge table linking SalesOrderHeader to SalesReason.

Sales.SalesPersonQuotaHistory.grain: one row per sales quota entry per date for a sales representative
rules: Tracks historical quota changes set for sales representatives over time.

Sales.SalesTerritoryHistory.grain: one row per sales representative territory assignment period
rules: Tracks historical assignment of sales representatives to sales territories.
A NULL EndDate indicates the representative's currently active territory.

Sales.SalesTaxRate.grain: one row per sales tax rate rule per state or province

Sales.ShoppingCartItem.grain: one row per shopping cart line item
rules: Do NOT join ShoppingCartItem to SalesOrderHeader or SalesOrderDetail as cart items are uncommitted web sessions.
